exposure: distance from the inferior border of the gestational sac to the external cervical os
Distance from the inferior border of the gestational sac to the external cervical os
cohort: Pregnant women with prior cesarean delivery who underwent first-trimester sonographic examinations and third-trimester sonography for placenta previa or low-lying placenta between September 1997 and October 2011
finding: In women with persistent placenta previa or low-lying placenta and prior cesarean delivery, the smallest anterior myometrial thickness on first-trimester sonography, along with the number of prior cesarean deliveries, significantly improved the prediction of morbidly adherent placenta.
